title: Final: lights and materials
cards/0/task: From scratch: a shaded knot that casts a shadow on the floor, with a Lambert material.
cards/1/q: The scene is set up right and the camera points at the model, but the screen is black. The model uses MeshStandardMaterial. First guess?
cards/1/explain: Temporarily switch to MeshNormalMaterial or add an AmbientLight, and check.
cards/2/q: Which line is unnecessary for the knot's shadow?
cards/2/explain: AmbientLight casts no shadows: it has no direction.
cards/3/q: Match the symptom to the cause
cards/3/pairs/1/1: Only Ambient, or a Basic material
cards/3/pairs/2/1: One of the four flags is missing
cards/3/pairs/3/0: Lamp does not reach from afar
cards/4/q: What makes a scene heavier for the GPU? Select all that apply.
cards/4/explain: Basic is the cheapest material there is.
cards/5/explain: And do not forget an environment map: metal needs something to reflect.
cards/6/q: What makes MeshStandardMaterial better than Lambert?
cards/6/options/0: It is physically based: highlights, roughness, metal, and it matches glTF materials
cards/6/explain: Use Lambert when you want cheap and no highlights.
cards/7/task: Only ambient light, so the knot looks flat. Give it depth without touching the material.
